req.title: Retrieve player by squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber} with the player wearing that squad number.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber}. I design tests across EP (valid squad number returns correct player), NEG (non-existent squad number returns 404, non-integer path returns 422), and BVA (boundary squad numbers: 1 lowest in DB, 26 highest in DB, 0 below minimum, 27 above maximum). Each test asserts exact HTTP status codes and exact payload field values to kill comparison-operator, constant-bump, and boolean-negation mutations. The endpoint URL in the source is /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} (lowercase 'n'), which I use exactly.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range
preconditions: Database contains player with squadNumber=10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
expected: Response body contains exact field values for squad number 10
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'DM'
    assert body['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
    assert 'id' in body
    assert body['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'

test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range()
